messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: paging webhook POST /v1/pagerbridge -> 401 auth_failed (invalid_token). Pages not delivered to downstream providers. Automatic retries paused.

miriam: seeing this on the dashboard — starts ~09:02 UTC. ~5 customers affected, backlog growing.

raj: who is the current SRE primary? @oncall-rota-bot please escalate.

oncall-rota-bot: Primary oncall: sam (sre-sam). Paging sam now.

sam: on it. tailing pagerbridge logs — getting repeated 'invalid_token' from auth-service. Token-rotator reported success at 08:55 but the token is missing in KV.

olivia: token-rotator POSTs to auth service and then writes to redis. I can see a 500 from redis at 08:55 — cert mismatch after the cert rotation.

miriam: so rotation partially succeeded (auth service rotated) but redis rejected write? that would cause missing tokens.

raj: manual mitigation options: 1) hotpatch pagerbridge to use long-lived admin token, 2) roll back certs, 3) bring redis node back to cluster. Which is fastest?

sam: fastest is (1) to restore paging quickly. I'm going to apply a short-lived admin token to secrets and restart the deployment. I'll note the risk.

miriam: agree — customer impact priority > token hygiene for now. notify legal if we have to expose admin token.

sam: running: kubectl set secret generic pagerbridge-auth --from-literal=token=<REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerbridge

incident-bot: Pagerbridge started accepting pages again. Backlog drain initiated, 6 pages sent successfully (customers: A, B, C).

olivia: I'll work on the redis side — looks like cert-manager rotated the certs but one redis node didn't pick up the new CA, causing client auth rejects. Trying to rejoin the node.

raj: nice. Can we add a short smoke test to token-rotator so future partial failures are detected?

miriam: yes — followups: 1) add idempotency & verification to token-rotator (olivia) 2) add a synthetic check that verifies pagerbridge auth after rotation (raj) 3) emergency runbook for admin-token hotpatch (miriam -> doc).

sam: I've posted a short playbook in the runbooks repo: https://git.internal/runbooks/pagerbridge-hotpatch (internal link). Please review.

incident-bot: Logs: auth failures dropped to 0 in last 15m; 3 retries completed during backlog drain. Last delivered page 09:40 UTC.

olivia: opened PR to add fallback to service-account token if redis write fails (link: https://git.internal/pagerbridge/pulls/234). Still testing.

miriam: I'll draft customer updates and send to CS + legal for review. Also scheduling a retro for tomorrow to walk the incident.

raj: can we confirm there were no missed high-severity pages? any customers escalate outside Redwood?

sam: received two customer DMs about delayed pages but no downstream outages reported. Support has notified customers A and B.

miriam: owners assigned: olivia -> token-rotator fix + redis remediation, raj -> synthetic checks + runbook update, sam -> patch cleanup and verify no admin token left in logs/secrets, miriam -> customer comms + retro.

olivia: I'll follow up in the PR and post test results here.

sam: once PR merged and redis stable we'll rotate credentials properly and remove admin hotpatch.

miriam: thanks everyone. Marking incident resolved for now — will track follow-ups in the retro. :white_check_mark:
